description: a bush of pink peonies. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: a cheerful old town in cherry blossom season: frames in cream white and warm wood, shutters and doors in soft pink, mint green or sky blue, rounded friendly shapes, flowers wherever they fit

layers.shapeDescription: A wide heart shape with a slightly jagged bottom edge.
An oval petal with a small notch at the top.
A narrow teardrop shape with a curved side.
A soft bumpy circle representing the pollen center.
